versions.description_html:
Learn how Microsoft Entra ID Protection detects password attacks, evaluates sign-in and user risk, and automates security to protect your cloud environment.

Microsoft says more than 97 percent of identity attacks are just password attacks. The usual way into a Microsoft 365 account is a password that leaked somewhere else, not a clever hack.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Identity Protection Actually Watches
  • Two Kinds of Risk: The User and the Sign-In
  • What the Risk Levels Mean
  • How Risk Turns Into a Decision
  • How People Fix It Themselves
  • What the Admin Actually Sees
  • What It Costs and What You Need
  • Best Practices That Actually Matter
  • A Quick Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
